slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether batches must pass through all three vats in a fixed sequence; instead it assumed each batch is assigned to exactly one vat.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each batch is processed entirely in exactly one vat, rather than passing through all three vats in a fixed sequence.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked whether a batch can be split across vats, but did not ask about the required vat sequence; it then modeled the problem as unrelated parallel-machine scheduling with one vat per batch.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about the required vat processing sequence remained unresolved and was silently assumed away.

summary: The agent clarified several scheduling details but missed the key vat-sequence constraint, silently converting the problem into unrelated parallel-machine scheduling and stopping with a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
